invariants.rationale: The method is expected to always return some write metadata object; returning null would indicate a severe failure.
The method expects the records list to be non-null as it is directly passed to the executor.
A non-null instantTime is necessary for versioned upsert logic.
If no input records are provided, then the write status output should be empty. Non-empty write statuses imply at least one input record.
The returned metadata should always provide a non-null list of write statuses.
